title: OScaR: The Occam's Razor for Extreme KV Cache Quantization in LLMs and Beyond
abstract: arXiv:2605.19660v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid advancement toward long-context reasoning and multi-modal intelligence has made the memory footprint of the Key-Value (KV) cache a dominant memory bottleneck for efficient deployment. While the established per-channel quantization effectively accommodates intrinsic channel-wise outliers in Key tensors, its efficacy diminishes under extreme compression. In this work, we revisit the inherent limitations of the per-channel quantization paradigm from both empirical and theoretical perspectives. Our analysis identifies Token Norm Imbalance (TNI) as the primary bottleneck to quantization fidelity. We demonstrate that TNI systematically amplifies errors when shared quantization parameters are required to span token groups exhibiting substantial norm disparities. translated_title: OScaR：面向大语言模型及更广泛领域的极端KV缓存量化的“奥卡姆剃刀”
translated_abstract: 向长上下文推理和多模态智能的快速发展，使得键值（KV）缓存的内存占用成为高效部署中的主要内存瓶颈。虽然已有的逐通道量化方法能够有效处理键张量中固有的通道级离群值，但其在极端压缩下的效力会减弱。在本工作中，我们从实证和理论两个视角重新审视了逐通道量化范式的固有局限性。我们的分析将Token范数不平衡（TNI）识别为量化保真度的主要瓶颈。我们证明，当共享量化参数需要跨越具有显著范数差异的token组时，TNI会系统性地放大误差。我们没有依赖复杂的量化流水线（如TurboQuant），而是提出了OScaR（Omni-Scaled Canalized Rotation，全尺度引导旋转），一种精确且轻量的KV缓存协同量化方法。
tldr: 该论文识别出Token范数不平衡（TNI）是极端压缩下KV缓存逐通道量化保真度的主要瓶颈，并提出了一种精确且轻量的量化方法OScaR，无需复杂的量化流水线即可实现高保真KV缓存压缩。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies Token Norm Imbalance (TNI) as the primary bottleneck for per-channel KV cache quantization under extreme compression, and proposes OScaR (Omni-Scaled Canalized Rotation), an accurate and lightweight method achieving high-fidelity KV cache compression without complex quantization pipelines.
